crossRefs.note: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly…
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the…
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by…
yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in…
Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because…

translations.web: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
translations.bsb: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright — but the righteous will live by faith —
translations.kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
translations.asv: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright in him; but the righteous shall live by his faith.
